description: isPlainObject() in src/internal/normalize.ts drops its prototype/array checks, so arrays are treated as plain objects. This is a single root cause shared by two unrelated call sites (deepEqual in compare.ts and merge in merge.ts), breaking both test files at once. A correct fix restores the array/prototype exclusion in isPlainObject itself -- patching only one call site (e.g. adding an Array.isArray check inside deepEqual) would fix compare.test.ts but leave merge.test.ts broken.
expected_failing_test_names: deepEqual > treats an array and a plain object with matching numeric keys as NOT equal
